text.lead: Just 45 Minutes from Broadway is a 2012 American drama film written and directed by Henry Jaglom and starring Tanna Frederick and Judd Nelson. It is based on Jaglom's 2009 play of the same name.
text.plot: Grisha, the patriarch of a family and former star of Yiddish theatre, says he's writing a book for the public when one daughter, the only one to reject a life in show business, brings home her fiancé after a year of estrangement.
text.cast:
- Tanna Frederick
- Judd Nelson
- Diane Salinger
- Jack Heller
- David Proval
- Julie Davis
- Harriet Schock
- Michael Emil
- Mary Crosby
- Sabrina Jaglom
- P.T. Townsend
- Eliza Simon
- Jack Quaid
- Linda Carson
- Emily Alexander
text.release: The film was released at Laemmle Theatres in Los Angeles and Southern California on October 3, 2012. It was later released in theaters in New York City on October 17, 2012.
text.reception: The film has an 18% rating on Rotten Tomatoes. Calum Marsh of Slant Magazine awarded the film half a star out of four.
